title: An Act to Require the Development of Better Cannabis Testing Criteria and Processes

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to require the development of better cannabis testing criteria and processes.

status_label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310

final_disposition.label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310

chamber_actions.action: Received by the Clerk of the House on March 6, 2025.

Carried over, in the same posture, to the next special or regular session of the 132nd Legislature, pursuant to Joint Order SP 519.
